company.shortDescription: tEQuitable is an independent, confidential platform to address issues of bias, discrimination and harassment in the workplace.
company.description:
tEQuitable’s mission is to help companies create a safe, inclusive and equitable workplace — work culture that works for everyone.

tEQuitable is an independent, confidential platform to address bias and discrimination in the workplace. They provide a resource to employees for issues ranging from subtle to severe and they provide data and insights to companies to identify and improve systemic workplace culture issues.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,817,533 to $10,899,522, a 3.87x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 16 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 59 (-8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
